wholeGoal.title: Tier- und Pflanzenarten bestimmen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann unterschiedliche Tier- und Pflanzenarten mithilfe geeigneter Merkmale und Bestimmungshilfen bestimmen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can identify different animal and plant species using suitable traits and identification aids.

ownLogicalDerivation: With only the feature unlobed, both B (Syringa vulgaris) and D (Fagus sylvatica) satisfy the key. The revised task no longer falsely claims that the uniquely discriminating heart shape alone is insufficient.

The complete P1 card has opposite arrangement plus unlobed/heart-shaped leaves, following the A/B branch to B. The P2 card has alternate arrangement plus rounded lobes, following C/D to C. Thus main solutions and stepwise justification are coherent.

P3 supplies unlobed without arrangement or complete shape. No confident species identification follows. Observing arrangement on an intact shoot and then form distinguishes remaining B/D without inventing missing data.

The animal second case likewise separates six-leg group support from uncertain species identification when wing structure is missing. T1/T2 use several supplied traits; colour alone and a world-wide species claim are correctly rejected.
casesAndProfiles.wholeProfileAndRubricReview: Two expectation families cover both positive tracing and limits/missing evidence, across plant and animal contexts. Rubrics are paired scope references, not extra mandatory task counts or a claim that a single case proves every criterion. DE/EN task, expected answers and changed premise agree.

wholeGoal.title: Fossildaten und Datierung
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Fossilfunde, Datierungsmethoden und deren Aussagekraft für Stammbäume bewerten.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can evaluate fossil finds, dating methods, and their significance for family trees.

ownLogicalDerivation: The C14 rule now requires suitable carbon-bearing material in a much shorter usable age interval, rather than exclusively organic origin. Appropriate inorganic carbonates are correctly admitted conditionally, with initial content, reservoir effects, later exchange and calendar-age calibration explicitly assessed. The supplied million-year volcanic-ash dating proposal remains unsuitable.

The lower ash is 2.4±0.1 Ma and upper ash 1.8±0.1 Ma. For an undisturbed sequence their conservative outside bounds are 2.5 and 1.7 Ma, so the fossil lies within 1.7–2.5 Ma, not at an invented point date. Ash crystallisation age is distinguished from direct biological fossil age.
Reworking an older fossil destroys the secure two-sided biological-age bracket; its true age may exceed the old maximum bound. The ash crystallisation dates need not change.

In the other complete case, P:D=1:3 under initially zero daughter and closed-system assumptions gives P/(P+D)=1/4, two half-lives and 2 Ma. Daughter loss reduces D and increases apparent parent fraction, yielding too few elapsed half-lives and underestimated age.

Shared derived morphology supports a relationship/dated lineage occurrence but cannot choose direct ancestor versus extinct sister from age and the supplied traits alone. The worked solutions retain that inferential limit.
casesAndProfiles.wholeProfileAndRubricReview: Radiometric/stratigraphic conditional bounds, method suitability and phylogenetic limits are addressed across the two whole cases and genuinely changed reworking/daughter-loss transfers. DE/EN scope and conclusions agree. Constructed examples remain distinct from measurements and learner performance.

truthfulStatusToBeCheckedAfterFIRST: AI machine evidence, needsHumanReview and E1/G1 ceilings; no human approval or performed experiment inferred.
